title: PoppyApproval
description: An approval of one revision of an operation, user approved or agent approved (the Personal Agent approved on the User's instruction), sent by the Personal Agent. Operations extension 5 and 6. In a conversation message's extensions.operations.approval, or in an MCP tool call's _meta under personalagentprotocol.org/approval. At APIs, the same members go in the Poppy-Approval header as a Dictionary Structured Field. Unknown members are ignored. A Personal Agent never sends input_type with an agent approval; a Company that receives one ignores it rather than rejecting the approval.

approver.description: user for a user approval, agent for an agent approval on the User's instruction. Operations extension 5 and 6.

approved_at.description: In Unix seconds. With user, when the User approved. With agent, when the Personal Agent approved. Operations extension 6.

input_type.description: Only with user, never with agent. How the User gave their answer, such as tap, typed, or voice. Other values are allowed. Operations extension 6.

reference.description: An opaque ID for the Personal Agent's own record of the approval, such as a ledger entry. Never the same at two Companies. Operations extension 6.
